title: Assessing feature scorer results on high-dimensional datasets with t-SNE
abstract: arXiv:2610.39009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While vast literature on high-dimensional data visualization is available, there are not many works regarding the visualization of feature scorers and their results. Feature scorers are algorithms that assign numerical importance to each feature of multi-dimensional datasets. These importance scores can be used in several applications, such as feature selection, knowledge discovery, and machine learning interpretability. There are several feature scorers to choose from, and often no single metric or ground truth is available to guarantee the quality of their results. In this scenario, visualization can become valuable to support the decision of which method to choose and how good its results are. For this goal, this work presents "weighted t-SNE." translated_title: 使用 t-SNE 评估高维数据集上特征评分器的结果
translated_abstract: 尽管关于高维数据可视化的文献十分丰富，但针对特征评分器及其结果可视化的工作却不多。特征评分器是一类为多维数据集中每个特征分配数值重要性的算法。这些重要性分数可用于多种应用场景，如特征选择、知识发现和机器学习可解释性。目前存在多种可选的特征评分器，且通常没有单一的度量标准或真实标准（ground truth）可以保证其结果的质量。在这种情形下，可视化可以成为支持决策的宝贵工具，帮助判断应选择哪种方法以及其结果的好坏。为此，本工作提出了“加权 t-SNE”（weighted t-SNE），它修改了嵌入二维空间中数据点之间的关系，以反映特征评分器所评估出的原始数据集各维度的重要性。
tldr: 本文提出“加权 t-SNE”方法，通过根据特征评分器给出的各维度重要性来调整二维嵌入空间中数据点之间的关系，从而实现对高维数据集上特征评分结果的可视化评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "weighted t-SNE," which modifies the relationships between data points in the embedded 2D space to reflect the per-dimension importance scores assigned by a feature scorer, enabling visual assessment of feature scorer results on high-dimensional datasets.
